dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for talking with me.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 高3で受験生なのですが、気になる人がいて、勉強に集中できず困っています
dialogue.English: I'm a high school senior preparing for entrance exams, but there's someone I'm interested in, and I'm having trouble concentrating on my studies.

dialogue.content: 勉強に集中なさりたいのにお気になる方の事を考えてしまわれるのですね
dialogue.English: So, you want to concentrate on your studies, but you find yourself thinking about this person instead.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お勉強の成績に支障はでているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it affecting your academic performance?

dialogue.content: うーんよくわからないです
dialogue.English: Hmm, I'm not really sure.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも時間がもったいなくて
dialogue.English: But I feel like I'm wasting time.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やることはたくさんあるはずなのに
dialogue.English: Even though there are so many things I should be doing.

dialogue.content: お相手の方は、どのような立ち位置のかたなのですか？
dialogue.English: What is your relationship with this person?

dialogue.content: 同じ塾の人です
dialogue.English: They're from the same cram school as me.

dialogue.content: 学校はちがいます
dialogue.English: We go to different schools.

dialogue.content: おなじ生徒です
dialogue.English: We're both students there.

dialogue.content: 塾がご一緒なのですねでは、会われる頻度も多いのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you go to the same cram school. Do you see each other often, then?

dialogue.content: 週1回です
dialogue.English: Once a week.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、お会いにならなくてもやらなければならない事や考えてしまう時間ももったいないと感じてもしまわれるのですね
dialogue.English: But even when you don’t see them, you end up thinking about them and feel that time could be better spent on what you need to do.

dialogue.content: はいいろいろと気になって考えてしまいます
dialogue.English: Yes, various things come to mind, and I end up thinking about them.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's understandable.

dialogue.content: 想像してしまうというか・・・
dialogue.English: I end up imagining things...

dialogue.content: 気になる。と仰られておられましたが・・・気がつくと考えてしまってるご自身がいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're interested in them... and before you realize it, you find yourself thinking about them.

dialogue.content: そうですね勉強しているはずなのにいつのまにかという感じで
dialogue.English: That's right. I should be studying, but before I know it, my mind has wandered to them.

dialogue.content: セーブできるものならしたい感じですよね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you wish you could control it if you could.

dialogue.content: はい受験成功したいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to succeed in my exams.

dialogue.content: おそらく、受験にむけてここまで頑張ってこられたのだと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine you’ve worked very hard toward your exams up to this point.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: 無駄にしたくない気持ちは強いですよね
dialogue.English: You must have a strong desire not to let all that effort go to waste.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 浪人もしたくないです
dialogue.English: And I don't want to have to retake the exams next year.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 気が付くと考えてしまってる。というのは具体的にどんな事ですか？
dialogue.English: When you say you find yourself thinking about them, what sort of things do you think about specifically?

dialogue.content: 問題を解こうと考えていたりするといつのまにかとか
dialogue.English: Like when I’m trying to solve a problem—before I know it, my mind drifts.

dialogue.content: 英語の単語の暗記の時とか
dialogue.English: Or when I’m memorizing English vocabulary.

dialogue.content: 大事な時にお相手さんは現れますね！
dialogue.English: So they pop into your head at the most important times!

dialogue.content: はいそうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: お気になるようになられたのはいつからでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When did you start feeling interested in them?

dialogue.content: 3年生になったころからです4ヶ月ぐらい？
dialogue.English: Since around the start of my senior year. About four months ago?

dialogue.content: 受験時の4か月は長いですよね
dialogue.English: Four months during exam season can feel long, can’t it?

dialogue.content: 一番の焦る時期でもありますし
dialogue.English: It's also the most anxious time.

dialogue.content: そうですね焦らないといけない時期なのに
dialogue.English: That's right, even though it's a time when I need to feel a sense of urgency.

dialogue.content: いいかげんに気持ちを切り替えないとと思うのですが
dialogue.English: I feel like I need to just get my head on straight, but...

dialogue.content: 受験の一番大事な時期でもあり、浪人もしたくなくここまで頑張ってこられたのに、気になる相手に気が付くと気持ちがもっていかれてしまい焦っておられる。という事でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, to summarize: this is the most crucial time for your exams, you don't want to have to retake them next year, and you've worked hard up to this point. But you find your thoughts getting carried away by this person you're interested in, and it's making you anxious. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 大事な時に気が付くと心？頭？に現れるお相手の方の対処法は今まではどのようになされてきましたか？
dialogue.English: When that person suddenly pops into your mind at those crucial moments, how have you been coping with it so far?

dialogue.content: 実は中高女子校だったこともあって中学からは、そんなこととは無縁でした。
dialogue.English: Actually, I went to an all-girls middle and high school, so I haven't really had any experience with this sort of thing since middle school.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 進学校ですし部活も文化系で・・・
dialogue.English: It's a college-prep school, and my club was in the cultural/arts area, so...

dialogue.content: ええ初めて気になるお相手なのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so this is the first time you’ve been interested in someone like this.

dialogue.content: そういうことですよね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: 小学校とかはありましたが・・・
dialogue.English: I mean, I had crushes in elementary school...

dialogue.content: その時は受験も大変ではないから
dialogue.English: But exams weren't such a big deal back then.

dialogue.content: 受験で焦る気持ちと、思春期になって初めて気持ちが傾いた事に戸惑いもお持ちなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Perhaps you’re feeling both the pressure from the exams and some confusion about experiencing these feelings for the first time as a teenager?

dialogue.content: うーん多分そういうことですよね
dialogue.English: Hmm, I guess that's probably it.

dialogue.content: どうしていいかまったく
dialogue.English: I honestly have no idea what to do.

dialogue.content: 戸惑うことばかりですよね
dialogue.English: It’s all quite bewildering, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: 集中できていない自分も嫌になります
dialogue.English: I also dislike myself for not being able to concentrate.

dialogue.content: 気になってしまう。とおっしゃられていましたが・・・恋ですよね？
dialogue.English: You said you're 'interested'... Is it a crush?

dialogue.content: そういうことですよね
dialogue.English: I guess that’s what it is.

dialogue.content: でも、付き合いたいとかそういうのはないというか
dialogue.English: But it's not like I want to date them or anything.

dialogue.content: 恋心をセーブなさるのは至難の業ですよねでも、どこかでご自身なりにケジメをつけたいと。
dialogue.English: Controlling romantic feelings is incredibly difficult, isn't it? But it sounds like you want to draw a line for yourself somewhere.

dialogue.content: はいほんとうにそうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly it.

dialogue.content: 受験が終わってからにしたい
dialogue.English: I want to put it off until after my exams are over.

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね！！タイミングが悪かった・・・
dialogue.English: Absolutely!! The timing is just awful...

dialogue.content: つらいです
dialogue.English: It's tough.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、思いどうりにならないことですし・・・至難の業だとは思いますが、どこかご自身の中で、工夫することは必要かと思います
dialogue.English: I understand. It's not something you can control as you'd like... It may be extremely difficult, but I think it's necessary to find some way to manage it for yourself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですなにかありませんか？
dialogue.English: That's right. Do you have any suggestions?

dialogue.content: 例えば、考える時間。というものを作りとことん考える。で、
dialogue.English: For example, you could set aside a dedicated “thinking time” and allow yourself to think about it thoroughly. And then...

dialogue.content: 何をですか？
dialogue.English: Think about what?

dialogue.content: お相手のことですね集中している時に現れたら、ひと呼吸しにメリハリをつける。
dialogue.English: About them. If thoughts of them appear while you're trying to concentrate, you could take a breath to create a clear separation.

dialogue.content: 先に相手のことをとことん考えて？
dialogue.English: So, I think about them thoroughly first?

dialogue.content: そのあと集中する感じ？ですか？
dialogue.English: And then try to concentrate after that? Is that the idea?

dialogue.content: お勉強以外の時間などに。
dialogue.English: During your non-study time.

dialogue.content: そうはしてるんですけどね
dialogue.English: I kind of do that already, though.

dialogue.content: それともいっその事、忘れる努力？でも週一でお会いしていたら忘れは出来ないですよね
dialogue.English: Or perhaps, try to forget about them altogether? But if you see them once a week, that would be impossible, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: 家に帰って少しくつろいでいる時とかにも考えたりしてるんですよね
dialogue.English: I do think about them when I get home and relax a bit, too.

dialogue.content: 忘れらるなら忘れたいですよね
dialogue.English: If I could forget, I would.

dialogue.content: ご自身でも工夫はなされておられる訳ですよね・・・
dialogue.English: So you have been trying to manage this in your own way...

dialogue.content: きらいになればいいのかな？？むりかな
dialogue.English: Maybe I should try to dislike them? But that's probably impossible.

dialogue.content: 工夫というか自然とそうです
dialogue.English: It's not so much a conscious effort; it just happens naturally.

dialogue.content: 自然になさっておられたのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you were doing it naturally.

dialogue.content: だから勉強の時間ぐらいは集中しないとと思っているのに余計気になっている感じのような
dialogue.English: That's why I feel like I have to concentrate at least during study time, but that just seems to make me even more aware of them.

dialogue.content: だめと思えば余計に・・・・
dialogue.English: The more I tell myself I shouldn't, the more I think about it...

dialogue.content: ご自分でセーブなさっておられると余計にな感じですね
dialogue.English: So when you try to control it yourself, it actually becomes stronger.

dialogue.content: はい悪循環な気がします
dialogue.English: Yes, it feels like a vicious cycle.

dialogue.content: そうですね・・・受験の難問より難問ですね！！
dialogue.English: I agree... This is a tougher problem than any on your exams!

dialogue.content: そうですね難問です
dialogue.English: Yes, it’s a tough problem.

dialogue.content: 解けません
dialogue.English: I can't solve it.

dialogue.content: 焦る気持ちは充分に伝わってきましたが他に工夫が出来ると良いのですが・・・恋は病ともいいますし。
dialogue.English: I can certainly feel your anxiety. It would be good if we could find some other strategy... but as they say, love is like an illness.

dialogue.content: ほんと困りました
dialogue.English: I’m really at a loss.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんはそんなことなかったですか？
dialogue.English: Counselor, have you ever experienced something like this?

dialogue.content: ありましたね！！学生時代・・・
dialogue.English: I did! Back when I was a student...

dialogue.content: そうですかどんなでした？
dialogue.English: Really? What was it like?

dialogue.content: 苦しかった気持ちだけは覚えています！
dialogue.English: All I remember is how painful it was!

dialogue.content: そうなんですね苦しい・・・仕方がないのですね
dialogue.English: I see... it's painful. I guess it can't be helped, then.

dialogue.content: お話聞いていただいてありがとうございました。ちょっとすっきりしました
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me. I feel a little relieved.

dialogue.content: 楽しかったです
dialogue.English: It was nice talking to you.

dialogue.content: また、なにかありましたらご相談におこしくださいね
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please feel free to come and talk with me again.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.
